title: The build queue, rebuilt
headline: Builds that used to queue for twenty minutes at peak now start in under two, and the nightly retry pages have stopped. Here's how six people (and a few friends on other teams) got us there.

chapters.title: Finding the real problem
chapters.what: Two outages pointed at the queue; the team traced both to retries firing in lockstep and a cache that never let go.

contributors.name: Bea
contributors.did: found the lockstep retries and shipped jittered backoff with a load test (#482)

contributors.name: Chen
contributors.did: joined the Tuesday-night outage off-rota and found the runaway cache eviction

chapters.title: Building it so it stays fixed
chapters.what: A load-test harness and a new cache layer, designed in the open.

contributors.name: Chen
contributors.did: built the load-test harness and wrote the guide three teams now use

contributors.name: Dami
contributors.did: wrote the cache layer design doc whose trade-offs table settled a month of debate

contributors.name: Ola
contributors.did: reviewed every tiling-related change and kept the compiler team in the loop

chapters.title: Rolling it out
chapters.what: A staged rollout across regions, with a new teammate shipping from week one.

contributors.name: Dami
contributors.did: ran the staged rollout to 100% in the US and unblocked the eu region

contributors.name: Kenji
contributors.did: fixed the flaky queue test in his first week, so rollouts stopped being retried by hand

contributors.name: Arjun
contributors.did: turned around the eu config change once it was flagged

quotes.text: Chen's setup notes got me shipping in my first week.
The cache design doc answered every question the compiler team had.
Two weeks without a single retry page.

also_thanks.name: Ravi (Compiler team)
also_thanks.for: testing the NPU tiling pass against the harness and sending fixes back

also_thanks.name: Priyanka
also_thanks.for: protecting two weeks of focus time for the redesign

closing: Thank you, team. This is what it looks like when everyone makes everyone else better.
